system.description:
Prerequisites: Advanced Auspex, Advanced Chimerstry. Coming from the Indian Brahmin juti and through them to the Phuri Dae, this power is used as punishment upon those who deserve worse than mere destruction. The Ravnos draws his victim's greatest fear forth to plague her night and day. The nightmare creature is perceptible only to the victim (though it can occasionally make its presence known in small ways to others) and always takes a form relevant to the victim's fears.

System: The player spends one point of Willpower (two for Cainite targets) and rolls Perception + Intimidation (difficulty equal to the target's Willpower rating) while the Ravnos concentrates for a full turn, drawing forth the victim's greatest fear and giving it life for one night per success. Traditionally the Ravnos makes eye contact with the victim, though this is not strictly necessary: a +1 difficulty penalty applies if the victim is within sight but eye contact is not made, and a +2 penalty applies if the victim is within a mile and the Ravnos has a personal item of hers to focus upon. Beyond that range, or without such a focus, the power cannot be used. The curse's duration may be extended by spending blood when it is first summoned (one point per additional night); it vanishes at sunrise after its final night. During that time the victim suffers the effects of the Haunted and Nightmares Flaws.

Costs 20 Experience Traits to learn.

MET: The Ravnos spends one Willpower Trait (two against a Cainite) and wins a Social Challenge (retest Intimidation) against the victim's Willpower; success saddles the target with a personal nightmare tormentor (mechanically equivalent to the Haunted and Nightmares Flaws) for the remainder of the story, or longer if the Ravnos spends additional Blood Traits.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis IV: Thieves in the Night, Book One: Charlatans
system.duration: One night per success (extendable with blood)
